what_this_is: One row per requirement, scoring criterion and deliverable of the clustering nomination, each carrying either an artifact path that exists or a sentence naming what is missing.

deadline.submission: fill the form and attach links with view access

status_rule: met requires at least one cited path that exists; partial and deferred_by_decision require a failure sentence naming the gap; a row with neither is refused, because silence would otherwise read as satisfaction
recheck_rule: rows marked after_integration are provisional while the Earth Engine layers are being fetched and must be re-audited once the integrated panel exists

rows.quoted_from_page: сформировать пространство признаков (атрибутов), выбрав подходящие показатели из предложенных вариантов, и обосновать свой выбор
rows.note: The indicator set is being extended by the layers Earth Engine now answers for, so the justification has to be re-issued once those columns exist; the requirement itself is met.

rows.quoted_from_page: математически определить правило, по которому между двумя муниципалитетами создаётся связь (ребро)
rows.note: Seven families, each with a formula, a direction, guards and a sparsification rule. The brief's own suggestions are covered: distance between territories, correlation between monthly series, cosine similarity of spending vectors, lagged correlation and warping with an offset chosen by the data.

rows.quoted_from_page: обосновать выбранный способ построения рёбер и объяснить, какое влияние он оказывает на структуру сети и результаты кластеризации
rows.failure: The influence on network structure is measured - reciprocity, clustering coefficient, degree gini, top-1% adjacency, label-propagation modularity, dense versus kNN component counts - but the influence on the clustering result is not. No artifact yet compares cluster quality or interpretability with and without edge-derived features, which is the second half of this requirement. Task: edge-influence-on-clustering.

rows.quoted_from_page: предложить математический подход для отслеживания изменений кластеров во времени
rows.note: Monthly re-clustering with label churn and agreement against the aggregate partition, plus a maximal-overlap alignment for moving labels. The cadence of the inputs says spending updates monthly, so a monthly reading of the clusters is the one the data supports.

rows.quoted_from_page: оценить качество полученных кластеров, дать им содержательную интерпретацию и обосновать их экономическую осмысленность
rows.failure: Quality indices and a naming attempt exist, and a decision rule for "meaningfully different" was fixed before the experiments ran. What is missing is the verdict itself: whether the clusters can be named and defended rather than described as a list of unrelated characteristics, and whether the chosen k is the one the evidence supports. Tasks: sweep-k-interpretability, recluster-at-vintages.

rows.quoted_from_page: Допускается интеграция ... любых надёжных и публично доступных источников информации (the brief permits extra sources; this one was named by us, not by the page)
rows.failure: Dropped by the user's decision on 2026-10-08, not by failure of the source. Every identifier tried for it returns "not found": UMD/GLAD_/TREECOVER/CIRCUITRY/2020v1 and UMD/gladsat-foundation-data-v1, measured in artifacts/geo/asset_id_probe.json under the newly registered project. No requirement of the clustering nomination depends on it, so further identifier hunting was judged not worth the quota.

rows.quoted_from_page: Допускается интеграция ... любых надёжных и публично доступных источников информации (named by us, not by the page)
rows.failure: Dropped by the user's decision on 2026-10-08. GLAD/IFL/2021 and UMD/ifl_2021 both return "not found" under the registered project, measured in artifacts/geo/asset_id_probe.json. Nothing in the nomination requires intact-forest boundaries, and the land-production story is carried by cropland, grass and forest shares from classified land cover.
rows.note: The task page sharpens this requirement: the clusters must be interpreted as real types of local economies, not merely as groups that differ statistically. That is what the interpretability verdict in the k sweep has to answer, and it is why a cluster that cannot be named is reported as unnamed rather than being given a label drawn from whichever characteristics happen to differ.

rows.quoted_from_page: Простое и понятное объяснение разработанной методологии — 15%
Описание того, как строится сетевая и атрибутивная структура, — 15%
rows.note: The listed options are all present in some form. Dynamic Time Warping was the one missing and was added on 2026-10-08 as dynamic_alignment.

rows.quoted_from_page: математический подход к отслеживанию изменений кластеров во времени — 15% (the task page lists this as a scored criterion; the summary on the contest page lists "Сравнение методов — 15%" in the third slot instead. Both are carried, because the two lists differ and neither can be assumed to supersede the other.)
rows.note: The same artifact serves this criterion and the fourth listed requirement. Monthly re-clustering, label churn, agreement with the aggregate partition and a maximal-overlap alignment for moving labels are all measured rather than described.

rows.failure: The comparison covers k-means and Ward against the same index battery. The top-ranked competitor runs seven methods across an eleven-value k range, so a two-method comparison is thin against the criterion's own wording. Recorded as a named gap rather than presented as sufficient.

rows.quoted_from_page: Применение ICVI: SW, CH, S_Dbw, AVI, AVU, MQ — 15%
rows.note: All six named indices are computed; the attribute-based ones on the feature matrix and the graph-based ones on the adjacency matrix. This was checked by reading the artifact's columns rather than by trusting the docstring.

rows.quoted_from_page: Интерпретация результатов, ясность, воспроизводимость и обоснованность выводов — 30%
rows.failure: Reproducibility is measured - a manifest with byte-level verification and a model build that was shown to reproduce the committed artifacts. Interpretation and justification are what this goal exists to settle, so the row stays partial until the k sweep, the vintage comparison and the imputation test are measured.

Out of scope for this goal by the user's decision: submission preparation, including visualization and any landing or presentation, moves to a separate goal that replaces the dropped frontend one. Recorded as deferred rather than unmet, so the score risk is visible instead of silent.

rows.quoted_from_page: Чистый, хорошо документированный код: репозиторий GitHub; конфигурационные файлы (YAML/JSON) для настройки гиперпараметров; инструкцию по запуску проекта
Краткий методологический отчёт, написанный на русском языке
rows.note: It exists and is in Russian. It will not describe the integrated Earth Engine layers until they are built, and it must not claim otherwise; the update belongs to the submission goal.

rows.quoted_from_page: Презентацию в формате pdf или интерактивного лендинга с экономической интерпретацией результатов и визуализацией итогов
rows.failure: Deferred to the separate submission goal by the user's decision. A print/export view exists at web/presentation/export.html but nothing is rendered from it in this goal.

rows.quoted_from_page: Обязательным условием является использование минимум одного датасета СберИндекса
rows.note: Municipal consumer spending by category, monthly 2023-01 to 2024-12, is the core input, alongside the municipality reference with Oktmo identifiers.

rows.quoted_from_page: Допускается интеграция новостных источников, климатических и погодных данных, других экономических индикаторов или любых надёжных и публично доступных источников информации
rows.note: Remote sensing, official Rosstat statistics and OpenStreetMap geometry are integrated. GDELT news is named but not wired, and two sources - GLAD tree cover and Intact Forest Landscapes - are dropped by the user's decision rather than by failure.
